WHERE WE CELEBRATE

Casa Antares

A special place for our special day.

Photos: Fincas de la Villa · Bodas en Villa de Leyva / Laura Rincón

Our wedding will take place at Casa Antares, just outside Villa de Leyva — a colonial country house surrounded by gardens and lush greenery. This is where we want to welcome you, celebrate, and share an unforgettable day together.

Villa de Leyva is one of the most beautiful towns in Colombia, and there is plenty to discover in the surrounding area. Perhaps you'd like to turn our wedding into a few days of exploring and unwinding.

GOOD TO KNOW

Spring-like days.
Crisp nights.

Villa de Leyva enjoys a mild, temperate climate. Expect around 22 °C (72 °F) during the day, while nights cool down noticeably to about 12 °C (54 °F).
